name: BBQ Chicken, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Bake with Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Divide between two large baking dishes.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; large dice. Add to the dishes with the zucchini.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the dishes along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until veggies start to soften and chicken is partly cooked through, 10 minutes.

After 10 minutes of baking, remove dishes from the oven. Add barbecue sauce, stir to combine, and return baking dishes to the oven. Continue to bake until veggies are fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 (340 g) bags frozen, riced cauliflower
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cauliflower rice and BBQ chicken bake between plates. Enjoy!
